cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash that pan for two shopping trips. We price labour, please, not the number of objects in the sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's one pan. Two trips is ridiculous.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dried cheese is removal work, not rinsing. You are comparing entirely different categories of effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll soak it first. That gets most of the cheese off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one shopping trip, provided you empty the soaking water. Preparation must be complete before I discount the job.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 labour-versus-object pricing, A3 removal/rinsing distinction and A5 preparation condition make A an exacting estimator of favours.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges the rate and B4 offers effort that genuinely changes A work, so the bargain responds rather than escalates arbitrarily.

heightening.evidence: A5 acknowledges B4 useful contribution through a lower rate while insisting on complete preparation.

specificity.evidence: A1 pan for shopping trips and A3 dried cheese make the actual effort exchange clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 preparation condition specifies what B must do to obtain the discount, not a detached moral about fairness.
